caveat: Entity-level SOC statement lines for TAHE (Transport Asset Holding Entity of New South Wales) only. Never add to government program spending, to the PNFC sector benchmark, or to each other: the statement prints an explicit Total revenue and Total expenses; total revenue already includes the separately shown Grants and contributions line, total expenses already includes employee-related expenses, other operating expenses, other expenses, depreciation/amortisation/de-recognition and finance costs; the net result is a surplus. The FY2023-24 result is materially affected by a $17.8bn valuation increment and a change in grants recognition, so it is not comparable to prior years. Provisional and unverified.
